item.tib: klu 'dul byams ma'i phyag bzhes ku mud chun po
item.coloph: de ltar kong yul shar phyogs klu nang gi sngar spral pa'i rig 'dzin blo ldan snying po'i/ sngags sems thon pa bco lnga'i ya gyal lha rgyal bkra shis kyi gdung mtha' 'dzin pa'i rigs la mkho gal du bab tshe/ stag btsun g.yung drung ye shes kyis bskul ngor rig 'dzin grol gsang ba rtsal gyis stag rtse g.yung drung gling du sbyar zhing / yi ge pa ni tshe dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/
